findings.title: A kitchen extra loses its billing mark at the next Save after the BEO re-reads it, so a later quantity raise is never billed
findings.did: Reopened the BEO, raised the already billed kitchen extra dish A from 1 to 2, Save
findings.expected: Ticket comment: only the new source-quantity delta is charged, on a separate bill (as happened for the bar line in edge 7b)
findings.happened: No bill. Save answered synced. The kitchen plan and the till show dish A x2; the BEO says Extras charged at the till 60.07; the till charged 35.04 for kitchen extras (10.01 on the main receipt + 25.03 on Additional bill 1); the party shows Fully paid
findings.cause: apps/oto-app/client/src/components/beo/beo-event-editor.tsx: the kitchen load mapping (mapMenu) does not carry chargeApproved or billingSync, unlike the bar mapping; stored kitchen lines lose chargeApproved at the next Save (seen on the pre-settle dish, dish A and the free dish)

findings.title: No receipt for an additional bill
findings.happened: Desk and phone end on Payment recorded with no receipt number; the payment attempts have saleId null (party payments record no sale, receipt or VAT line by design: services/parties.ts payParty, Q3). Each bill has only its bill reference and its own payment record
